title: 第5章 结金丹享五百载寿元神通自生与天地争锋第6章 倾国之力为君求道
slug: 先秦炼气两千年世人误闯天家
content_zh:
顾长青心中暗道。
金丹，那才是真正踏上了长生之路的门槛。
寿元五百，神通自生，才算是在这修仙之路上，有了一点自保之力。
而想要结成金丹，所需要的资源和灵气，将是筑基的百倍，千倍！
光靠他自己，不知要修炼到猴年马月。
他还需要借助那个人的力量。
那个，即将成为天下之主的人。
就在此时，一名传令兵骑着快马，从远处疾驰而来，他甚至不敢靠近，在百丈之外便滚下马背，跪地高呼：“启禀上卿！陛下有旨！陛下已至泰山！宣上卿即刻前往，共行封禅大典！”
泰山封禅！
顾长青嘴角微微上扬。
他知道，自己等待的机会，来了。
他身形一动，化作一道青虹，瞬间消失在了天际。
只留下身后，数十万仍在跪地叩拜，满脸狂热的秦军士卒。
他们今日所见，必将作为神话，流传后世。
泰山，自古以来便被视为“五岳之首”，有“直通帝座”的说法。
在这里祭祀天地，宣告自己的功绩，是每一位有着雄心壮志的君王，毕生的梦想。
如今，嬴政做到了。
他灭六国，一统天下，功盖三皇，德高五帝。
他认为自己有足够的资格，来这里向天地昭告自己的伟业。
此刻，泰山之巅，筑起了一座高大的祭台。

嬴政身穿最隆重的十二章纹冕服，在文武百官的簇拥下，拾级而上。
他的步伐沉稳而有力，每一步，都踏在了历史的脉搏之上。
山风呼啸，吹动着他身后的玄色大纛猎猎作响。
李斯作为丞相，手捧祭文，跟在身后。
他看着嬴政的背影，心中充满了激动与自豪。
他亲身参与并见证了这个伟大时代的诞生。
百官们也都神情肃穆，他们知道，自己正在见证一个前无古人，甚至也后无来者的辉煌时刻。
当嬴政走上祭台的最高处，他转身，俯瞰着脚下的芸芸众生。
山川，河流，云海，尽收眼底。
“朕即是天下，天下即是朕”
的豪情，在他胸中激荡。
他完成了祭天之礼，昭告上天，他将采用“皇帝”这一称号，自称“始皇帝”，从此以后，他的子孙后代，将二世、三世，直至万世，永掌这片江山。
仪式完成，群臣山呼万岁。
content_en:
Gu Changqing thought to himself.
Golden elixir, that is the threshold to truly embark on the road to immortality.
With a life span of 500 years and the generation of supernatural powers, one can be considered as having some ability to protect himself on the road to immortality.
To form a golden elixir, the resources and spiritual energy required will be a hundred times or a thousand times that of foundation building!
Just relying on himself, he doesn't know how to cultivate until the year of the monkey.
He also needs to draw on that person's strength.
The one who is about to become the lord of the world.
At this moment, a messenger came galloping from a distance on a fast horse. He didn't even dare to get close. He rolled off his horse a hundred feet away, knelt down and shouted: "Your Majesty! Your Majesty has a decree! Your Majesty has arrived at Mount Tai! Your Majesty will go immediately to celebrate the Zen ceremony together!"
Taishan Fengchan!
The corners of Gu Changqing's mouth raised slightly.
He knew that the opportunity he had been waiting for had come.
His body moved, turned into a blue rainbow, and disappeared into the sky in an instant.
Behind him were hundreds of thousands of Qin soldiers who were still kneeling and worshiping with fanatical expressions on their faces.
What they see today will surely be passed down as a myth to future generations.
Mount Tai has been regarded as the "first of the five mountains" since ancient times and is said to be "directly connected to the throne of the emperor".
It is the lifelong dream of every ambitious king to worship the heaven and earth here and declare his achievements.
Now, Ying Zheng has done it.
He destroyed the six kingdoms and unified the world. His achievements were greater than those of the three emperors, and his virtue was as high as that of the five emperors.
He believed that he was qualified enough to come here to announce his great achievements to heaven and earth.
At this moment, a tall altar was built on the top of Mount Tai.
Ying Zheng, wearing the most solemn twelve-chapter crown uniform, climbed up the stairs surrounded by civil and military officials.
His steps are steady and powerful, and every step he takes steps on the pulse of history.
The mountain wind howled, blowing the big black paper behind him.
As the prime minister, Li Si followed behind him, holding a memorial in his hand.
He looked at Ying Zheng's back, his heart filled with excitement and pride.
He personally participated in and witnessed the birth of this great era.
All the officials also looked solemn. They knew that they were witnessing a glorious moment that was unprecedented and unprecedented.
When Ying Zheng walked to the highest point of the altar, he turned around and looked down at all the living beings at his feet.
Mountains, rivers, and sea of ​​clouds are all in sight.
"I am the world, and the world is me"
The pride surged in his chest.
He completed the ritual of offering sacrifices to heaven and announced to heaven that he would adopt the title of "Emperor" and call himself the "First Emperor". From then on, his descendants would control this country forever for the second, third, and even eternity.
The ceremony was completed and all the ministers shouted long live.
